description: Example cost scenario for a first try of is-this-backtest-lambo-or-lada when you have no cost file of your own. These are not your costs: the first-run setup shows them and uses them only after you confirm, and every summary and verdict-log entry then says "costs: example (not your own)" with C7 capped. Found them wrong for your broker? Give feedback, and use your own cost file (templates/costs.json).
source: maintainer's researched SPX scenario, IBKR-style fees

fields.entrySlippage: entry slippage per exit group (per side for a spread), in option points
fields.exitSlippage: slippage of a profit-target or time exit, in option points
fields.stopLossSlippage: slippage of a stop exit, in option points
fields.openingFees: fee per contract (per leg) to open, USD
fields.closingFees: fee per contract (per leg) to close, USD
